| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `qronos acp` | start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server |
| `qronos mcp` | manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers |
| `qronos [project]` | start qronos tui |
| `qronos attach <url>` | attach to a running qronos server |
| `qronos run [message..]` | run qronos with a message |
| `qronos debug` | debugging and troubleshooting tools |
| `qronos auth` | manage AI providers and credentials |
| `qronos agent` | manage agents |
| `qronos upgrade [target]` | upgrade qronos to the latest or a specific version |
| `qronos uninstall` | uninstall qronos and remove all related files |
| `qronos serve` | starts a headless qronos server |
| `qronos models [provider]` | list all available models |
| `qronos roll-call <filter>` | batch-test text models matching a filter for connectivity and latency |
| `qronos profile` | show Qronos account profile |
| `qronos auto` | custom auto routers: register client models and run client evals |
| `qronos stats` | show token usage and cost statistics |
| `qronos export [sessionID]` | export session data as JSON |
| `qronos import <file>` | import session data from JSON file or URL |
| `qronos github` | manage GitHub agent |
| `qronos pr` | manage pull requests |
| `qronos session` | manage sessions |
| `qronos remote` | enable remote connection for real-time session relay |
| `qronos daemon` | manage the local qronos daemon |
| `qronos console` | open or stop the local Qronos Console (deprecated) |
| `qronos cloud` | run Cloud Agent tasks |
| `qronos db` | database tools |
| `qronos config` | configuration tools |
| `qronos plugin <module>` | install plugin and update config |
| `qronos help [command]` | show full CLI reference |
